world.title: 12 Killed, 30 Injured As Suicide Bomber Blows Up Vehicle At Checkpoint In Pak
world.summary: A suicide bomber detonated an explosives-laden vehicle at a police checkpoint in northwestern Pakistan, resulting in at least 12 deaths and 30 injuries. The attack occurred on Saturday in Dera Ismail Khan. The Tehrik-e-Taliban Pakistan, also known as the Pakistani Taliban, claimed responsibility for the incident, according to statements from police and rescue officials.

world.title: Iran warns US bases across Middle East could be targeted if Washington ‘makes a mistake’
world.summary: Iran's military has issued a warning that US bases and interests throughout the Middle East may be targeted if the United States engages in military action against Tehran. This statement underscores rising tensions between the two nations, highlighting the potential for conflict in the region should Washington make what Iran perceives as a provocative move.

world.title: Thailand: Bangkok flooding triggers disaster declaration
world.summary: Heavy rainfall over three days has led to significant flooding in Bangkok, prompting authorities to declare a disaster in all 50 districts of the city. Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt noted that the eastern areas were particularly affected. The declaration aims to mobilize resources and support for affected residents as the city addresses the ongoing flooding situation.

business.title: Suzuki Aims To Reduce Car Weight By 100 Kgs - Without Compromising Safety
business.summary: Suzuki has announced a lightweight engineering initiative aimed at reducing vehicle weight by 100 kilograms while maintaining safety standards. This plan includes modifications to vehicle structures and components. Additionally, Suzuki intends to decrease the weight of CNG cylinders from 60 kilograms to 40 kilograms. The initiative is part of Suzuki's broader strategy to enhance fuel efficiency and performance.

business.title: India can achieve over 10 pc economic growth, says Sitharaman
business.summary: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that India has the potential to achieve over 10 percent economic growth. She emphasized the importance of increased adoption of various economic measures to reach this target. In a separate matter, the Election Commission of India clarified that all Special Intensive Revision orders received unanimous approval, addressing concerns about internal dissent among its commissioners.

business.title: DA hike July 2026: Will DA rise to 64% from 60%? ₹18,000, to ₹56,100 basic salary
business.summary: The organization is urging for the expedited declaration of the July 2026 Dearness Allowance (DA), which is projected to rise from 60% to 64% based on Consumer Price Index (CPI) data. They clarified that they are not seeking advance payments but want the pending process completed to settle arrears and revised salary payments, impacting basic salaries from ₹18,000 to ₹56,100.

technology.title: Less Accurate, More Confident: The More We Rely On AI, The Less We Question What We Think We Know
technology.summary: A study revealed that reliance on AI advice diminishes individuals' accuracy and their readiness to acknowledge uncertainty, while simultaneously boosting their confidence. Despite advancements, AI can still produce errors and misleading information. The findings suggest that increased trust in AI may lead to overconfidence in decision-making, potentially affecting critical thinking and evaluation of information.

technology.title: This Chinese device can detect trains running underground
technology.summary: Chinese researchers have developed a handheld quantum magnetometer capable of detecting underground subway trains. This innovation, led by Peng Xinhua and his team at the University of Science and Technology of China, was detailed in a study published in Acta Physica Sinica on September 14. The device's small size does not compromise its effectiveness in tracking subterranean movements.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series RAM and Storage Details Surfaces Online
technology.summary: Leaks have revealed details about the RAM and storage options for Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S27 series, expected in 2027. The information suggests various configurations for the flagship models, indicating Samsung's continued development of its high-end smartphones. This follows previous leaks about the devices, contributing to ongoing speculation regarding their specifications and features ahead of the official launch.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026 Live, September 26: Tajinder wins shot put silver, Gulveer storms into 1500m final
sports.summary: At the Asian Games on September 26, Tajinder Singh Toor secured a silver medal in men's shot put, while Gulveer advanced to the 1500m final. Animesh Kujur also reached the 200m final. The men's and women's kabaddi teams won gold earlier in the day. Heavy rain affected performances at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium.

sports.title: Kongan, Bhadra and Bolland reach Asian Games 2026 sprint finals
sports.summary: Nandhini Kongan qualified for the 100m hurdles final, while Harita Bhadra and Unnathi Bolland advanced to the 200m final at the Asian Games 2026. India continues to show strong prospects in women's sprint and hurdles events. Kongan secured fourth place in her semifinal, ensuring her spot in the final, contributing to India's overall performance in athletics.

sports.title: Vinod Kambli Struggles To Speak In Viral Video From Old Age Home, Fans Concerned
sports.summary: A viral video featuring former Indian cricketer Vinod Kambli has raised concerns among fans. In the emotional clip shared from an old age home, Kambli struggles to speak, highlighting his ongoing health issues over the past few years. The video has prompted reactions from supporters, who are worried about his well-being and the challenges he is facing.

health.title: 'How Do You Even Plan?' Man In His 80s Spends Rs 40 Lakh On Medical Emergency
health.summary: A man in his 80s faced significant financial strain after undergoing heart surgery costing approximately Rs 40 lakh. A social media post highlighted the challenges seniors encounter during medical emergencies, prompting discussions about the financial burdens of healthcare in old age. The situation raises concerns about how elderly individuals can effectively plan for unexpected medical expenses.

health.title: HIV injections keep virus suppressed better than daily pills: Study
health.summary: A clinical trial published in The Lancet indicates that long-acting HIV injections administered every eight weeks may be more effective at suppressing the virus in adolescents compared to daily antiretroviral tablets. The study highlights that only two adolescents in the injection group experienced viral rebound, suggesting a potential shift in treatment strategies for managing HIV in younger populations.

health.title: Health Capsules
health.summary: A study in the 'Indian Journal of Sleep Medicine' reveals that insomnia negatively impacts cognitive functions, including memory and attention. Conducted among undergraduate students, the research highlights the detrimental effects of sleep deprivation on emotional well-being and social interactions. The findings underscore the importance of addressing insomnia to improve overall mental health and cognitive performance in affected individuals.

science.title: Physical Chemistry Class 11 Introduction: Matter, States & Applications by PW
science.summary: Physical Chemistry Class 11 introduces fundamental concepts of matter, including the differences between solids, liquids, and gases, and the significance of intermolecular forces. Students will explore topics such as thermal energy, plasma, and Bose–Einstein condensate. The curriculum emphasizes understanding particle interactions and movements, along with the practical applications of Chemistry in fields like medicine, agriculture, sanitizers, and refrigeration.

science.title: Scientists found strange ‘Zombie Worms’ eating whale bones in the deep ocean, and their reproduction is even more bizarre
science.summary: Scientists discovered bone-eating zombie worms, known as Osedax, on a whale carcass in California's Monterey Canyon in 2002. These worms have a unique reproductive method, with females burrowing into bones to extract nutrients. This finding highlights a peculiar deep-sea ecosystem, showcasing the complex interactions between marine life and organic remains in the ocean's depths.

science.title: Earth's magnetic field might help treat Parkinson's and Alzheimer's
science.summary: Research led by Professor Lisa Chakrabarti at the University of Nottingham explores the effects of Earth's magnetic field on cellular functions, potentially aiding treatments for Parkinson's and Alzheimer's diseases. Experiments conducted with fruit flies compared healthy specimens to those with neurodegenerative conditions, aiming to understand how this invisible force influences biological processes and could lead to innovative therapeutic strategies.

entertainment.title: Yami Gautam's family celebrates her first National Award for 'Article 370' with hugs, flowers and besan ka halwa, sister Surilie captures the emotional moment
entertainment.summary: Yami Gautam celebrated winning her first National Film Award for Best Actress for her role in 'Article 370' at the 72nd National Film Awards. Her family marked the occasion with hugs, flowers, and besan ka halwa. The emotional moment was captured by her sister, Surilie. Gautam's husband, filmmaker Aditya Dhar, also joined in the celebration.

entertainment.title: Sai Pallavi Serves Understated Elegance In A Silk Saree At Ramayana Event In Mumbai
entertainment.summary: Sai Pallavi attended a promotional event for Nitesh Tiwari's film Ramayana in Mumbai, where she plays Sita. The event marked the beginning of promotions for Part 1, scheduled to release on November 8, 2026. Sai Pallavi showcased understated elegance in a silk saree during the event, which was held at the DNEG/Prime Focus office.

entertainment.title: Sidharth Malhotra And Tamannaah Bhatia Starrer Earned Rs 8 Crore On Day 1
entertainment.summary: Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia's film, The Vvaan: Force Of The Forest, debuted in theaters on September 25. It earned an estimated Rs 8 crore net in India on its first day, screening across 6,746 shows. The film has garnered mixed reviews from both critics and audiences, reflecting a varied reception since its release.
